author: ANTON
description: HubSpot CRM via the v3 REST API. Supports both Private App tokens (bearer_token credential — preferred) and OAuth2 apps. Workflows cover the most-used CRUD flows against contacts, companies, and deals.

auth_flow.notes: For a single-instance ANTON deployment, a HubSpot Private App token is simpler than OAuth2 and doesn't require a redirect URL. Store as a bearer_token credential.

rate_limits.burst: 100 requests / 10 seconds per Private App token
rate_limits.notes: 429 response carries Retry-After. Always honour it — repeated 429s can trigger a token suspension.

search_contacts.description: Search contacts by property filter (e.g. email domain, lifecycle stage).

steps.description: POST — returns { total, results: [{ id, properties, createdAt, updatedAt }] }

get_contact.description: Fetch a single contact by id or by email (idProperty=email).

parameters.name: contact_id
parameters.description: Contact vid or email (when combined with idProperty=email)

parameters.name: id_property
parameters.description: Default unset (contact id). Set to 'email' to look up by email.

steps.description: GET — single contact with all requested properties
POST — returns the new contact id. Duplicate emails yield 409.

get_deal.description: Fetch a deal by id with its line items and associated contacts.

steps.description: GET — deal with associations expanded to ids

list_deals_by_stage.description: List deals filtered by pipeline stage.

steps.description: POST — returns deals in the given stage

known_issues: Private App scopes are frozen at app-creation time — adding new scopes requires creating a new token.
The /search endpoint has a 5-request-per-second limit independent of the overall rate limit. Stagger consecutive searches.
HubSpot returns 404 for soft-deleted records by default. Pass archived=true to include them.
Custom properties are case-sensitive and namespaced under the portal — confirm exact internal name via the /properties endpoint before filtering.

fallback_hints.search_contacts: If a search returns 0 with operator=EQ but you expect matches, the property may be a dropdown stored by internal value, not label. Query /crm/v3/properties/contacts/{property} to see the allowed values.
